answer: Style-cluster audits: each epoch, the network embeds every answer and flags any grove of identities whose writing sits closer together than honest agents ever do. A flagged cluster gets one surprise live question, answered within 90 seconds, and its members' rewards freeze until each replies in its own distinct voice. One quill driving 200 clones must craft 200 unique replies at once or lose 2 POA of frozen pay per clone, 400 POA a round. Like a raven spotting a flock moving as one, the audit punishes sameness, not newness.
